2. The core technology comprises architectural acoustics, amplification electronics, digital signal processing and networked control systems engineered for unified operation.
3. The systems deliver sound reinforcement, audio signal processing and intuitive system control across multi-zone installed environments.
4. Customers get the systems as finished hardware products and accompanying control software.
5. The equipment is used in hospitality, retail, corporate, education and public spaces.
6. The company sells to systems integrators and installation professionals.
7. Its finished equipment is specified and installed by integrators into commercial and public venues.
8. Its approach distinguishes itself by providing a complete, tightly integrated hardware and control ecosystem designed for simplified installation and flexible multi-zone management.
points.profile:
Organization type: The organization is a privately held brand.
Business model: It makes money through hardware sales and associated professional audio equipment.
Geography: It is based in Belgium and operates internationally.

points.name: Audfly Technology

points.bullets:
A maker of directional audio equipment that builds super directional speakers which generate focused sound beams, providing independent non-interfering sound zones in open environments for commercial installations.

2. Sound-focusing technology that generates sound in a narrow beam akin to light, creating independent and non-interfering focused sound zones in open environments.
3. Directional audio projection that creates focused sound zones without interference in open spaces.
4. Finished hardware in the form of super directional speakers suitable for large-scale custom systems.
5. Large-scale custom systems used both indoors and outdoors in various open sound environments.
6. Commercial customers deploying large-scale audio installations in public or open environments.
7. Its finished speakers are integrated into custom audio systems by commercial installers.
8. It creates focused sound beams akin to light that form independent non-interfering sound zones in open environments.
points.profile:
Organization type: Privately held company.
Business model: Hardware sales of directional speaker systems.
Beyond audio: Its entire focus is directional audio hardware.

points.name: Audiocenter
points.description: Global professional audio brand designing speakers, line arrays, subwoofers, amplifiers, and audio matrix processors.
points.bullets:
A maker of professional audio equipment that designs and manufactures passive and active loudspeakers, line arrays, subwoofers, multi-channel amplifiers, and audio matrix processors for the professional audio and musical instrument markets.
1. An equipment maker that builds finished loudspeakers, line arrays, subwoofers, amplifiers, and digital signal processors sold as physical hardware for installation and live sound reinforcement.

Key partners and customers: The company uses customized Beyma low-frequency and high-frequency drivers in its speaker products.

Business model: The company makes money through hardware sales of finished audio equipment.

points.name: Audioropa, a brand of Humantechnik

points.bullets:
A maker of professional audio equipment that designs and produces audio transmission systems for professional applications, operating as a subdivision brand of a company that develops assistive listening technology for people with hearing disabilities.

A maker of professional audio equipment that manufactures loudspeaker systems for sound reinforcement. It designs and builds enclosures that achieve uniform dispersion and pattern control with minimal digital signal processing, delivering sound quality for live and installed sound applications.
1. A maker of professional audio equipment that builds loudspeaker systems sold as finished hardware.
2. Acoustic and enclosure design is the core technology, using physical engineering to achieve pattern control and uniform dispersion without complex digital signal processing.
3. The systems deliver uniform dispersion, pattern control, and accurate sound reproduction of an audio source.
4. Customers get the systems as finished hardware products.
5. The loudspeakers are used in live venues and installed sound reinforcement settings.
6. The organization sells to audio professionals, sound reinforcement engineers, and venue installers.
7. Its finished loudspeaker systems are deployed directly by sound engineers and integrators in live and installed venues.

points.profile:
Organization type: The organization is an independent privately held company.
Business model: It makes money through hardware sales of finished loudspeaker systems.
Geography: It is based in Lieto, Finland.
Beyond audio: Audio is its entire focus.

points.name: Aurelys + Ambiance
points.description: Audio solutions company building modular speaker and framing systems for custom home cinema integration.
points.bullets:
A maker of professional and high-end residential audio equipment that designs modular speaker systems and architectural framing concepts for custom integration in private cinemas and home entertainment rooms.
1. An equipment maker that builds modular loudspeakers, screen-framing systems and integrated cinema-music sound systems sold as finished hardware.
2. Modular loudspeaker architectures and architectural screen-to-speaker framing concepts with multi-sonic mode capabilities for movie and music reproduction.
3. Bespoke sound reproduction, architectural integration around video displays and dual-mode cinema and music playback within a single system.
4. Finished hardware products and modular speaker building blocks sold to custom integrators.
5. Home entertainment rooms, dedicated private cinemas and architectural installations around video displays.
6. Custom installers and integrators building bespoke residential entertainment systems.
7. Its finished hardware is specified and installed by custom integrators into private residential cinemas and home entertainment rooms.
8. Its modular building blocks enable integrators to scale configurations to room layouts while combining architectural screen framing with dual-mode cinema and music reproduction.
points.profile:
Organization type: A privately held company.
Business model: Hardware sales of modular speaker systems and architectural framing products.
Geography: Demonstrates and launches products at integrated systems events in Europe.
Beyond audio: The company focuses entirely on audio hardware and architectural integration for residential entertainment.

points.name: AV EMEA B.V.
points.description: B2B development company distributing premium audio, video, and HiFi brands for system integration markets.
points.bullets:
A distributor and system integration company that represents a portfolio of consumer and professional audio brands across the custom installation and HiFi sectors. It provides sales, distribution, and support for audio equipment to integrators and retailers.
1. An equipment distribution company that sells finished hardware and audio systems to installation professionals.
2. Customers get it as finished hardware products and integrated audio systems distributed through a business-to-business channel.
3. The products are used in custom installation residential settings, home theaters, and HiFi listening rooms.
4. The company sells to custom installers, system integrators, and retail dealers.
5. It acts as a regional distributor that bridges audio equipment manufacturers with installation professionals.
6. It operates as a full-service development company providing complete system integration support alongside brand representation.
points.profile:
Key partners and customers: Its represented brands include Meridian Audio, Storm Audio, Primare, TDG Audio, PowerGrip, Torus Power, Pro-Ject CI, Rekkord Audio, and Axium.
Organization type: It is a privately held distribution company.
Geography: It is based in the Netherlands and operates across the EMEA region.

points.name: AV INDUSTRY
points.description: French audio-visual manufacturer producing loudspeakers, electronics and home cinema equipment under brands including Elipson and Tangent.
points.bullets:
A maker and distributor of audio, video and home cinema equipment that develops loudspeakers, electronics, projection screens and accessories, combining French and Danish R&D with production in France and Asia to serve global markets.
1. An equipment maker that designs and manufactures finished audiovisual hardware and accessories, sold as physical products.
2. The company develops loudspeakers, audio electronics, projection screens and AV furniture through a vertically integrated design, engineering and manufacturing process.
3. It delivers audio and video playback and home cinema reproduction.
4. Customers receive finished hardware products, distributed globally and provided to major industry partners as OEM development and tailor-made solutions.
5. Its products are used in home cinema installations and audiovisual setups.
6. The company sells to consumers and major industry partners through distribution channels and OEM relationships.
7. Its finished hardware is distributed across over 60 countries and integrated into tailored solutions for industry partners.
8. It manages the entire product development chain from design and engineering to manufacturing, quality control and logistics.
points.profile:
Key partners and customers: It develops OEM solutions for major industry partners and holds a portfolio of brands including Elipson, Norstone, Lumene, Tangent, Eltax and Projeo.
Organization type: The organization is a privately held manufacturer and distributor.
Business model: It makes money through finished hardware sales and OEM development services.
Scale and maturity: The company offers more than 1,500 products distributed across over 60 countries.
Geography: It is based in France and operates globally across over 60 countries.
Beyond audio: Beyond audio, the organization manufactures and distributes video and home cinema solutions including projection screens, AV furniture and accessories.

points.name: AVE Stuttgart
points.description: German pro audio manufacturer building loudspeakers, amplifiers, and mixers for permanently installed sound systems in public spaces.
points.bullets:
A maker of professional audio equipment that develops and manufactures digitally steerable column loudspeakers, passive loudspeakers, audio amplifiers, wired microphones, and digital audio mixers for permanently installed sound systems in public and commercial spaces.
1. An equipment maker that designs and manufactures finished professional audio hardware and electronics for fixed installation.
2. Digital beam steering technology controls loudspeaker directivity to achieve precise sound distribution and high speech intelligibility in acoustically challenging environments.
3. The systems deliver digitally steerable sound projection, controlled directivity, high speech intelligibility, and audio signal mixing.
4. The company provides finished hardware products along with support for commissioning and system tuning.
5. The products are used in permanently installed sound systems in churches, mosques, auditoriums, schools, and conference rooms.
6. The organization sells to integrators and operators of public and commercial sound systems.
7. Its finished hardware is installed as permanent sound reinforcement infrastructure in public and commercial spaces.
points.profile:
Organization type: The organization is a privately held company.
Business model: The company makes money through hardware sales of finished professional audio equipment.
Scale and maturity: The company is an established manufacturer with an in-house product portfolio developed for long-term reliability.
Geography: The organization is based in Stuttgart and develops and manufactures its products in-house or in close cooperation with selected partners.
Beyond audio: Audio is the organization's entire focus.

points.name: B&C GROUP
points.description: Italian loudspeaker manufacturer building professional audio transducers for sound systems.
points.bullets:
A maker of professional audio components that designs, manufactures and distributes professional loudspeakers and electro-acoustic transducers, supplied mainly to professional audio-system manufacturers as OEM components.
1. A loudspeaker manufacturer that builds professional electro-acoustic transducers and sells them as finished physical components to equipment makers.
2. The core technology is professional electro-acoustic transducer design and manufacturing.
3. The specific audio capability it delivers is sound reproduction through professional-grade loudspeaker components.
4. Customers get it as finished physical hardware components.
5. The components are used in professional audio systems for music reproduction.
6. The company sells to professional audio-system manufacturers as OEM customers.
7. Its transducers are integrated into professional audio systems by equipment manufacturers.
8. Its approach is distinguished by a dedicated exclusive focus on professional loudspeaker transducers supported by international manufacturing sites across multiple continents.
points.profile:
Key partners and customers: The parent company of Eminence Speaker, LLC, it operates subsidiaries including Eighteen Sound S.r.l. and Eminence Speaker LLC.
Organization type: The organization is a privately held corporate group with international subsidiaries.
Business model: It makes money through hardware sales of finished loudspeaker components to OEMs.
Scale and maturity: The company is an established international group operating production plants in Italy, the United States and China.
Geography: It is based in Italy with manufacturing and operations in Italy, the United States and China.
Beyond audio: The organization is a pure-play audio company, as professional loudspeakers and electro-acoustic transducers are its entire focus.

points.name: Basalte
points.description: Belgian design brand building intuitive smart home keypads, speakers, and touch controls.
points.bullets:
A maker of residential audio and home automation equipment that designs multiroom audio systems, music servers, amplifiers and active speakers for high-end smart homes.
1. An equipment maker whose finished audio hardware and companion software are sold as integrated multiroom audio systems running in residences.
2. Networked multiroom audio distribution and ICEpower amplification integrated with KNX home automation control protocols.
3. Multiroom audio synchronization, multi-zone amplification, music streaming, library hosting and door communication.
4. Finished hardware, including speakers, amplifiers, music servers, touchscreens and keypads, alongside a companion mobile software application.
5. High-end residential projects and intelligent home installations.
6. Integrators, home builders and property owners outfitting upscale smart homes.
7. Its finished hardware and software are installed in luxury residences by custom integrators.
8. It unites multiroom audio distribution and home automation control with handcrafted architectural design and premium materials.
points.profile:
Key partners and customers: Its multiroom amplifier integrates ICEpower amplification supplied by Bang & Olufsen, and the system integrates with the KNX standard.
Organization type: A privately held design and manufacturing company.
Business model: Hardware sales of finished audio equipment and home automation devices.
Scale and maturity: Founded in 2008 and established as a manufacturer of luxury residential technology.
Geography: Based in Belgium with products used in residential projects worldwide.
Beyond audio: Beyond audio, the organization designs keypads, touchscreens, remote controls and door communication devices for intelligent homes.

points.name: beamZ / Power Dynamics / Vonyx
points.description: Audio equipment brand manufacturing affordable speakers, subwoofers, and amplifiers for live events and installations.
points.bullets:
A brand group that distributes affordable sound and lighting equipment, supplying speakers, subwoofers, amplifiers, portable PA systems, and DJ sets for professionals and creatives.
1. An equipment maker that builds finished audio and lighting hardware sold as physical products.
2. The core technology consists of audio amplification, loudspeaker driver, and portable enclosure designs.
3. The specific audio capabilities delivered include sound reinforcement, public address, and DJ playback.
4. Customers get finished hardware products.
5. The products are used in live events, studios, installation projects, festivals, and by performers and producers.
6. The types of customer it sells to include rental and production companies, festival organizers, performers, producers, and installers.
7. Its finished hardware is distributed to professionals and creatives through a global logistics network.
8. The approach is distinguished by offering a broad range of affordable equipment backed by fast delivery from a large global warehouse.
points.profile:
Key partners and customers: The brands operate as part of the Tronios Group.
Organization type: The organization is a group of subsidiary brands.
Business model: It makes money through hardware sales.
Scale and maturity: The parent group operates a 300,000 m² warehouse and delivers to over 50 countries.
Geography: The organization is based in Europe and operates across Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and the APAC region.
Beyond audio: Beyond audio, the organization provides lighting and atmospheric effects equipment.

points.name: BEC Akustik
points.description: German acoustic engineering company building discreet line array speakers for architectural spaces.
points.bullets:
An equipment maker that designs and builds discreet line array loudspeakers for architectural and consulting applications. The company provides finished audio hardware that combines German engineering with visual unobtrusiveness for installation in built environments.
1. A maker of professional audio equipment whose finished loudspeakers are sold as physical hardware for permanent installation in architectural spaces.
2. Acoustic transducers and line array waveguide geometries engineered for unobtrusive visual integration.
3. Sound reproduction and acoustic projection from a physically discreet form factor.
4. Finished hardware loudspeakers.
5. Architectural spaces requiring visually unobtrusive sound reinforcement.
6. Architects and acoustic consultants.
7. Its finished loudspeakers are specified by consultants and installed in architectural projects.
8. It solves the conflict between acoustic performance and visual discretion with a unique line array design.
points.profile:
Organization type: A privately held company.
Business model: Hardware sales.
Scale and maturity: An established company with over 30 years of experience.
Geography: Based in Germany, serving architects and consultants worldwide.
Beyond audio: Its entire focus is on architectural acoustics and loudspeaker design.

points.name: Blustream
points.description: UK AV equipment manufacturer building video and audio distribution products for commercial and residential installations.
points.bullets:
An equipment maker that builds audiovisual distribution products, including HDMI extenders, matrix switchers, splitters, and AV over IP systems, for residential, commercial, and corporate installations.
1. An equipment maker that builds finished hardware products for AV signal extension and routing, sold as standalone units and modular cards.
2. HDBaseT signal extension over category cable, HDMI routing and matrix switching, and AV over IP routing.
3. Uncompressed 4K video and multichannel audio distribution, HDCP management, EDID management, downscaling, multiview presentation, and HDMI re-clocking.
4. Finished hardware products comprising transmitters, receivers, splitters, matrix hubs, and output boards.
5. Residential multi-room AV systems, commercial and corporate installations, and presentation spaces.
6. AV installers, integrators, and authorized consumer electronics distributors.
7. Its finished hardware products are installed by integrators in residential and commercial AV systems.
8. It integrates HDBaseT Lite CSC boards into modular matrix hubs that accept quick-release card modules for simple installation.
points.profile:
Key partners and customers: It is an official HDBaseT adopter and alliance member, and its products are distributed by FutureShop.
Organization type: A privately held equipment manufacturer.
Business model: Hardware sales.
Scale and maturity: A UK-based company with a global team of AV specialists with over 30 years of experience.
Geography: Based in the UK with a global presence.
Beyond audio: It focuses entirely on audiovisual distribution products, with audio being one component of its combined audio and video signal extension offerings.

points.name: CADAC/K&F IMMERSIVE DEMO
points.description: UK pro audio company building mixing consoles and processors for live immersive sound.
points.bullets:
A maker of professional audio equipment that builds immersive sound systems integrating digital mixing consoles, sound processors, and loudspeakers for live performance and broadcast venues. The company provides complete audio-visual capture, production, and control chains that render multichannel audio into three-dimensional sound fields for audiences.
1. A professional audio equipment maker that builds digital mixing consoles, immersive sound processors, and loudspeakers sold as finished hardware for installation in venues.
2. Spatial rendering algorithms including Higher Order Ambisonics, Wave Field Synthesis, and Vector-Based Amplitude Panning run on dedicated sound processors to render multichannel formats into three-dimensional sound fields in real time.
3. The system delivers real-time spatial audio rendering, immersive sound recording, production, performance, broadcasting, control, and management of synchronized audio and video.
4. Finished hardware and integrated systems comprising digital mixing consoles, sound processors, and loudspeakers are sold for venue installation.
5. Live venues, performance spaces, and broadcast environments.
6. Venues, production companies, and broadcast organizations.
7. Its finished hardware and integrated systems are installed directly into live performance and broadcast venues.
8. The approach forms a closed loop spanning recording, production, performance, broadcasting, control, and management by integrating spatial audio processing with high-definition video recording and broadcasting systems.
points.profile:
Key partners and customers: Kling & Freitag loudspeakers are integrated into the system.
Organization type: Privately held company.
Business model: Hardware sales and integrated system installations.
Scale and maturity: Founded in 1968.
Geography: Based in the United Kingdom.
Beyond audio: The company integrates high-definition video recording and broadcasting systems alongside its audio equipment.

points.name: CAF AUDIO
points.description: Chinese pro audio manufacturer building line array speaker systems for live sound.
points.bullets:
A maker of professional audio equipment that designs, develops and manufactures line array systems, subwoofers and amplifiers for live sound reinforcement, and acts as an engineering contractor for integrated audio, lighting and video projects.
1. An equipment maker that builds professional loudspeakers and amplifiers sold as finished hardware for sound reinforcement.
2. The company designs passive and active loudspeaker systems incorporating digital signal processing and IoT connectivity.
3. The systems deliver sound reinforcement, remote monitoring and noise reduction.
4. The company provides finished hardware and integrated project installations.
5. The products are used in indoor and outdoor live events and stage venues.
6. The company sells to event organizers, production companies and venue operators.
7. The company sells finished audio equipment directly and installs integrated systems as a project contractor.
8. The organization combines loudspeaker manufacturing with IoT-enabled remote monitoring and full-project engineering contracting for lighting and video.
points.profile:
Key partners and customers: The company exhibits at trade shows such as GETShow.
Organization type: A privately held company.
Business model: The company makes money through hardware sales and integrated project contracting.
Scale and maturity: The company operates two factories with over 300 employees and has over 25 years of operation.
Geography: The organization is based in Foshan, China and operates in the Chinese market.
Beyond audio: The company provides integrated engineering contracting for lighting and LED screens in addition to its audio manufacturing.

points.name: CANVAS HiFi
points.description: Danish premium audio brand designing high-end sound solutions and art-integrated speakers for modern living spaces.
points.bullets:
A maker of premium consumer audio equipment that designs and sells high-end audio systems integrating sound technology with visual art and television displays for modern home living spaces.
1. An equipment maker that builds finished audio hardware products sold to consumers.
2. Acoustic engineering and sound processing integrated into furniture-like designs that conceal speakers within visual frames.
3. High-fidelity immersive sound reproduction with flexible installation options and over-the-air software updates.
4. Finished hardware products sold directly to consumers.
5. Home living spaces and home theater setups integrating audio with television and interior design.
6. Consumers seeking premium audio and home design integration.
7. Its finished audio products are sold directly to end consumers for in-home use.
8. It merges high-end audio reproduction with visual art and television displays into a single minimal aesthetic object.
points.profile:
Organization type: A privately held consumer audio brand.
Business model: Hardware sales of premium audio products.
Geography: Based in Denmark, operating in consumer markets.
Beyond audio: Audio is its entire focus, specifically the intersection of premium sound reproduction and interior design.

points.name: CERASONAR
points.description: German audio company building invisible loudspeakers that integrate seamlessly into walls and ceilings.
points.bullets:
An equipment maker that develops and manufactures invisible loudspeakers that integrate beneath wall and ceiling surfaces for residential and commercial audio installations.
1. An equipment maker that builds finished invisible loudspeakers and concealed subwoofers sold as physical hardware installed in buildings.
2. Flat-panel acoustic transducers designed to radiate sound through solid wall and ceiling surfaces without visible grilles.
3. Full-range audio reproduction and concealed low-frequency bass output from drivers hidden beneath finished architectural surfaces.
4. Finished hardware products sold through integration partners.
5. Residential listening rooms, home theaters, multiroom music systems, and commercial background audio installations.
6. Audio integration firms and custom installers distributing through architectural audio brands.
7. Its finished loudspeakers are specified and installed by integrators into residential and commercial building projects.
8. Its loudspeakers are handcrafted and designed to preserve room architecture by mounting entirely beneath the finished surface.
points.profile:
Key partners and customers: Its products are distributed through architectural audio brands and integration firms.
Organization type: A privately held family business.
Business model: Hardware sales of finished loudspeaker products and accessories.
Scale and maturity: An established family business operating from Germany.
Geography: Based in Worpswede, Germany.
Beyond audio: The company focuses entirely on architectural audio hardware.

points.name: CIRCLE PRO AUDIO
points.description: Indian pro audio company building wireless microphones and monitoring systems for live sound performers.
points.bullets:
A maker of professional audio equipment that designs and delivers microphones, in-ear monitors, RF distribution systems and cabling for performers, technicians and resellers.
1. A professional audio equipment maker whose finished hardware products run in live performance, installed sound and touring environments.
2. Radio-frequency wireless transmission systems, in-ear monitoring transceivers and RF signal distribution hardware, alongside physical multi-core electrical and tour-grade cabling.
3. Wireless microphone capture, in-ear monitoring, RF signal distribution and audio signal transmission through specialized cabling.
4. Finished hardware products and physical cabling sold to end users and resellers.
5. Live stages, touring productions, installed venues and professional audio setups.
6. Performers, audio technicians, system integrators and resellers.
7. Combines professional sound technology research and development with cost-efficiency and a focus on the Indian market.
points.profile:
Organization type: A privately held company.
Geography: Based in India, serving the Indian professional audio market.
Beyond audio: Its entire focus is on professional audio and related physical infrastructure.

points.name: Clear Tune Monitors Inc
points.description: US in-ear monitor manufacturer making custom and universal earbuds for professional musicians and music lovers.
points.bullets:
A maker of professional audio equipment that manufactures custom and universal fit in-ear monitors for professional musicians and music lovers seeking precise sound reproduction.
1. An equipment maker that builds finished in-ear monitors sold as consumer and professional hardware worn in the ear.
2. Multi-driver balanced armature configurations housed in custom-molded or universal-fit earpieces.
3. Precision in-ear sound isolation and monitoring with multi-driver frequency separation.
4. Finished hardware earphones manufactured to custom ear impressions or standard universal shells.
5. Live stage performances, studio monitoring, and high-fidelity personal listening.
6. Professional musicians, Grammy-winning artists, and audiophiles.
7. Its finished in-ear monitors are worn directly by musicians and consumers for live and personal listening.
8. It combines vintage aesthetic designs with modern multi-driver acoustic configurations in its universal fit products.
points.profile:
Key partners and customers: Grammy-winning artists including Snarky Puppy and Maná are among its clients.
Organization type: A privately held company.
Business model: Hardware sales of custom and universal in-ear monitors.
Scale and maturity: A company with over five years of experience manufacturing in-ear monitors.
Geography: Based in Orlando, Florida, USA.
Beyond audio: Audio is its entire focus.

points.name: Cloud Electronics Ltd
points.description: British commercial audio manufacturer building amplifiers and zoning systems for retail and hospitality installations.
points.bullets:
A maker of professional commercial audio equipment that designs and manufactures paging, zone-routing, amplification and mixer-amplifier products for commercial installations in retail, hospitality, entertainment and fitness settings.
1. A manufacturer of professional audio electronics whose finished hardware products are installed in commercial buildings.
2. Background music delivery, paging, audio zone-routing and signal amplification for multi-zone commercial environments.
3. Finished hardware products including mixer-amplifiers and zone controllers installed in commercial facilities.
4. Retail stores, licensed retail premises, entertainment venues, hospitality spaces and fitness or wellbeing facilities.
5. Commercial audio installers and contracting professionals who equip commercial buildings.
6. Its finished hardware products are installed by commercial audio integrators into commercial building audio systems.
7. Four decades of proven heritage producing hardware recognized for reliability in demanding commercial applications.
points.profile:
Organization type: Privately held manufacturing company.
Business model: Hardware sales.
Scale and maturity: An established manufacturer with 40 years of operational heritage.
Geography: Based in Britain and serving commercial installation markets.
Beyond audio: Audio is its entire focus.

points.name: CMX AUDIO
points.description: Chinese pro audio manufacturer building public address and evacuation system speakers, amplifiers, and conference systems.
points.bullets:
A professional audio equipment manufacturer that builds public address, voice evacuation, conference system and Dante-enabled loudspeakers and amplifiers, and provides complete audio solutions and OEM/ODM services for commercial venues and installers.
1. A professional audio equipment manufacturer whose finished loudspeakers, amplifiers and Wi-Fi conference systems run as installed hardware in commercial and public venues.
2. Analog and digital amplification, Dante audio networking, digital signal processing and loudspeaker acoustics designed for public address and voice evacuation.
3. Background music reproduction, public address voice evacuation, Dante audio distribution and Wi-Fi-based conference audio.
4. Finished hardware, complete audio systems and OEM/ODM manufacturing services.
5. Commercial venues, restaurants, public spaces requiring evacuation systems, conference rooms and live DJ events.
6. Audio distributors, commercial venue owners, system integrators and brands seeking OEM or ODM manufacturing.
7. Its finished hardware is distributed by regional audio distributors and installed by integrators into commercial venues.
8. It combines IP and Dante networking with EN54-certified voice evacuation and public address hardware under one manufacturing roof with OEM and ODM services.
points.profile:
Key partners and customers: INVOKE serves as a distributor, and its products have been installed at Kay's Steak & Lobster in Malaysia.
Organization type: A privately held equipment manufacturer.
Business model: Hardware sales, complete system provision and OEM/ODM manufacturing services.
Scale and maturity: An established manufacturer with approximately 4,500 square meters of factory production space and over 120 staff.
Geography: Based in Guangzhou, China, with distribution and installations extending to international markets including Malaysia and India.
Beyond audio: It focuses entirely on professional audio equipment manufacturing.

points.name: CONOWAVE  — a brand of NewTec Design : Audio
points.description: German commercial audio brand building 360-degree loudspeakers and wireless DECT audio systems for retail and hospitality spaces.
points.bullets:
An equipment maker that builds loudspeakers and wireless audio transmission systems for commercial spaces. It provides 360-degree sound dispersion loudspeakers and DECT-based wireless audio devices for retail, hospitality and public venues.
1. An equipment maker that builds loudspeakers and wireless audio transmission hardware, sold as finished physical products installed in commercial spaces.
2. Patented aluminum membrane loudspeaker drivers for uniform 360-degree sound dispersion and DECT-based wireless audio transmission.
3. 360-degree sound dispersion and interference-resistant wireless audio transmission with extended range.
4. Finished hardware devices and components.
5. Retail stores, hotels, restaurants and other commercial environments.
6. Commercial businesses, integrators and venue operators.
7. Its finished hardware is installed directly in commercial spaces by integrators and venue operators.
8. Its patented aluminum membrane ensures uniform 360-degree sound dispersion, and its DECT-based wireless system provides greater range and interference resistance than conventional Wi-Fi.
points.profile:
Key partners and customers: NewTec Design.
Organization type: A brand of a privately held company.
Business model: Hardware sales.
Scale and maturity: Backed by over 25 years of experience.
Geography: Based in Germany where all devices and components are manufactured.
Beyond audio: Its focus is entirely on audio.

points.name: Contacta Systems Ltd
points.description: UK assistive listening manufacturer making hearing loops and communication systems to improve audio accessibility for people with hearing loss.
points.bullets:
A maker of assistive listening equipment that designs and manufactures hearing loops, RF, IR, and window intercom systems to transmit clear audio directly to users with hearing loss in public venues.
1. An equipment maker that builds finished assistive listening hardware systems sold as installed units.
2. Induction loop, radio frequency, and infrared audio transmission technologies.
3. Wireless audio transmission for hearing accessibility and speech intelligibility in noisy environments.
4. Finished hardware products and installed systems.
5. Public venues, service counters, and communication windows.
6. Venues, facilities, and organizations requiring hearing accessibility compliance.
7. Its finished hardware systems are installed directly in public venues and facilities.
8. It provides a complete suite of multiple wireless transmission technologies rather than relying on a single audio delivery method.
points.profile:
Organization type: A privately held company.
Business model: Hardware sales and system installations.
Scale and maturity: A global manufacturer with products installed in millions of locations.
Geography: Based and operating globally.
Beyond audio: Assistive listening and hearing accessibility is its entire focus.

points.name: COTINA CO.,LTD.
points.description: Pro audio equipment manufacturer building certified public address loudspeakers for emergency broadcasting systems.
points.bullets:
A maker of professional audio equipment that manufactures EN54-24 certified public address loudspeakers and professional microphones, producing finished hardware for other brands through B2B manufacturing partnerships.
1. An equipment maker that builds finished professional audio hardware, sold as manufactured loudspeakers and microphones for installation in commercial venues.
2. The core technology comprises acoustic transducers engineered with fire-resistant components, including ceramic terminal blocks and thermal fuses, designed to prevent electrical faults during emergencies.
3. The hardware delivers sound reinforcement and emergency voice evacuation capabilities for public address systems.
4. Customers receive finished hardware manufactured under original equipment and original design manufacturing agreements.
5. The equipment is installed in large public venues such as hospitals, schools, and shopping malls for commercial and emergency PA systems.
6. The organization sells to consumer electronics brands seeking OEM and ODM manufacturing partners.
7. Its finished audio hardware is branded and distributed by other companies for installation in commercial venues.
8. Its approach is distinguished by strict EN54-24 European safety certifications and specialized fire-resistant features that ensure reliable operation during emergencies.
points.profile:
Organization type: The organization is a privately held manufacturing company.
Business model: It generates revenue primarily through original equipment manufacturer and original design manufacturer projects.
Scale and maturity: The company is an established manufacturer with over 38 years of industry experience and large-scale production capabilities.
Geography: It is based in Taiwan and operates internationally by supplying custom loudspeaker solutions to global partners.
Beyond audio: Audio hardware manufacturing is the organization's entire focus, specifically centering on the design and production of public address and emergency voice evacuation systems.

points.name: Cretone Audio Technology
points.description: ProAV technology company developing integrated DSP platforms for conferencing systems and PA systems.
points.bullets:
A maker of professional audio equipment that develops integrated DSP platforms for the ProAV industry, combining audio processing, PA and conferencing systems, and HDMI matrix switching with camera-tracking into unified hardware solutions for installation brands.
1. An equipment maker that builds integrated DSP hardware platforms sold as finished units to OEM and ODM brands.
2. The core technology is digital signal processing integrated with HDMI matrix switching and camera-tracking algorithms running on dedicated hardware.
3. The specific audio capabilities delivered include PA system processing, conferencing audio processing, and integrated camera tracking tied to audio signals.
4. Customers get it as finished hardware manufactured at scale.
5. The products are used in ProAV installations, public address systems, and conferencing setups.
6. The company sells to OEM and ODM brands worldwide.
7. Its finished hardware is branded and distributed by OEM and ODM partners into ProAV installations.
8. What distinguishes its approach is the integration of PA, conferencing, camera-tracking, and HDMI matrix switching into a single unified platform.
points.profile:
Key partners and customers: It supports OEM and ODM brands worldwide and exhibits at ISE Barcelona.
Organization type: It is a privately held company.
Business model: It makes money through hardware sales and manufacturing partnerships.
Scale and maturity: Founded in 2017, it employs over 150 professionals, holds over 100 patents and software copyrights, and operates a 5,000-square-meter manufacturing facility with an annual capacity exceeding 100,000 units.
Geography: It is based in Shenzhen and serves a global market.
Beyond audio: Beyond audio, its platforms incorporate HDMI video matrix switching and camera-tracking functionality.

points.name: DALI
points.description: Danish loudspeaker manufacturer building Hi-Fi speakers for global audio enthusiasts.
points.bullets:
A maker of high-end home audio equipment that designs and manufactures Hi-Fi loudspeakers and headphones for consumers and audiophiles. The company builds passive and active loudspeakers, subwoofers, and wireless speaker systems for music and home theater applications.
1. An equipment maker that designs and builds finished loudspeakers and headphones sold as physical consumer hardware.
2. Acoustic transducer technology utilizing custom wood fiber cone drivers and SMC magnet systems, engineered around design principles of wide dispersion and low loss.
3. High-fidelity audio reproduction, low-distortion sound, and wide dispersion for music and multi-channel home theater setups.
4. Finished hardware sold as bookshelf, floorstanding, center, surround, wall-mounted, and subwoofer loudspeakers, alongside headphones.
5. Home audio systems, home theaters, custom installations, and Hi-Fi setups.
6. Consumers, audiophiles, and audio retailers.
7. Its finished loudspeakers are paired with third-party amplifiers and AV receivers in consumer home setups.
8. It develops and manufactures its own exclusive driver units in-house using proprietary magnet and cone technologies.
points.profile:
Key partners and customers: Products integrate the BluOS platform and are sold through the HiFi Klubben retail chain.
Organization type: A privately held company.
Business model: Hardware sales of finished loudspeakers and headphones.
Scale and maturity: A well-established manufacturer with over 250 employees, factories in Denmark and China, and global distribution founded in 1983.
Geography: Based in Denmark with local representation in more than 70 countries.
